stories.title: Berlin: Anklage gegen Ex-rbb-Intendantin Schlesinger zugelassen

en.title: Berlin: Charges Against Former rbb Director Schlesinger Admitted
en.summary: A Berlin court has approved charges against former rbb director Patricia Schlesinger, including allegations of breach of trust. Schlesinger denies the accusations.

stories.title: Deutscher Schulpreis: Bertha-von-Suttner-Schule in Hessen gewinnt Hauptpreis

en.title: German School Prize: Bertha-von-Suttner School in Hesse Wins Main Award
en.summary: The Bertha-von-Suttner school in Mörfelden-Walldorf received the German School Prize for its educational approach, despite only 15 percent of its students initially receiving gymnasium recommendations. Six additional schools were also honored.

stories.title: Deutscher Schulpreis: 30.000 Euro für Schule - Jury lobt Praxisnähe

en.title: German School Prize: 30,000 Euros for School - Jury Praises Practical Orientation
en.summary: A school has won the German School Prize, which includes a 30,000 euro award, for its practical approach to education.

stories.title: Deutscher Schulpreis 2026: Deutscher Schulpreis geht an Schule im hessischen Mörfelden-Walldorf

en.title: German School Prize 2026: German School Prize Goes to School in Hessian Mörfelden-Walldorf
en.summary: The Bertha-von-Suttner comprehensive school won the German School Prize for its thoughtful approach to data management. Five other schools also received the award.

stories.title: Deutscher Schulpreis geht in diesem Jahr an Bertha-von-Suttner-Schule in Mörfelden-Walldorf/Hessen

en.title: German School Prize awarded to Bertha-von-Suttner-Schule in Mörfelden-Walldorf/Hesse this year
en.summary: The Bertha-von-Suttner-Schule in Mörfelden-Walldorf, Hesse has received the German School Prize for this year.

stories.title: Skandal beim RBB: Prozess gegen ehemalige Intendantin Schlesinger

en.title: RBB scandal: Trial against former director Schlesinger
en.summary: A legal proceeding has been initiated against the former director of public broadcaster RBB over allegations of breach of trust stemming from a scandal that emerged in summer 2022.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Rubio sieht ausländischen Akteur hinter möglichem Anschlagsversuch auf US-Basis

en.title: USA under Trump: Rubio sees foreign actor behind possible attack attempt on US base
en.summary: Secretary of State Rubio has attributed a potential attack on a US military facility to foreign involvement, while Trump has scaled down planned military exercises with South Korea.

stories.title: FIFA-Präsident Gianni Infantino stellt Verbänden mehr Geld in Aussicht

en.title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino offers associations more money
en.summary: FIFA President Infantino has signalled willingness to reform the world football association and promised increased funding to continental confederations, with a review potentially occurring in October.

stories.title: Großrazzia - Offenbar rund eine Million gefälschte Handys im Umlauf

en.title: Major raid - Around one million counterfeit mobile phones in circulation
en.summary: Authorities conducted a raid against a suspected criminal gang accused of selling approximately one million substandard counterfeit mobile phones disguised as Samsung models and evading taxes.

en.title: Bundestag debate culture: Klöckner threatens disruptors with expulsion
en.summary: Bundestag President Klöckner warned of increasing polarization in parliament and announced consequences for repeated disruptions, including potential expulsion of entire factions, and criticized social media-focused theatrics.

stories.title: Deutschland-Liveblog: Klöckner droht bei Störungen im Bundestag mit Rauswurf ganzer Fraktionen

en.title: Germany live blog: Klöckner threatens entire factions with expulsion for Bundestag disruptions
en.summary: Bundestag President Klöckner criticized behavior by AfD and Left party representatives and threatened expulsion of entire factions for disruptions, while Bavaria warned Berlin of financial consequences regarding a potential Left party government.

en.title: News blog on federal politics: Klöckner threatens AfD and Left factions with expulsion
en.summary: Bundestag President Klöckner expressed concern about increasing polarization in parliament and announced stricter enforcement measures against disruptions in future sessions.

en.title: Banks: Unicredit wants to take control at Commerzbank as quickly as possible and remove CEO Orlopp
en.summary: UniCredit plans to hold an extraordinary shareholder meeting to replace Commerzbank's supervisory board and management, disregarding the German government's position on the matter.

en.summary: Switzerland's financial regulator concluded that Julius Baer violated supervisory regulations. The Zurich bank announced a share buyback program to investors in response.
